title: AuthoringInterface
description: Every exchanged shape, so one generated declaration file shares its definitions.

ArtifactVisitsV1.description: Segments remain separate even if a later migration returns to the same artifact.

placement.description: The body block after which the choice point appears; only the last one may omit it.

proposals.description: Whether the host may propose options and passages here at run time (ADR 0013 §5).

ComparisonBudgetV1.description:
Per-assessment limits, also bound to the confirmation in this driver. Values may only
tighten the core's limits. JSON integers fit exactly in JavaScript.

CompositionLock.description: Written next to the project manifest as `project.lock.json`.

ContentOutline.description:
A content provider's outline (ADR 0013 §4): block order and choice-point markers of each
content unit, without text. It lets `compose` check placement order without the documents.

DeletedId.description: Only continuation positions can declare recovery; options cannot relocate a state.

GraphFiles.description: Bootstrap references for object-id-named files in the companion `.graph/` directory.

GraphRef.description:
A graph of one package instance. Package aliases and graph names are composition
structure, so unlike node aliases they are part of the artifact identity.

load_bytes.description:
Cumulative encoded reply receipt/acceptance threshold. One conforming bounded reply
may arrive before rejection, before maintenance/cache acceptance and Wasm transfer.
This does not bound host allocation or I/O before the host returns its reply.

loads.description: Host load calls, including retries on a cold cache.

MintedIds.description: Newly minted IDs; none of them occurred in the minter's occupied set.

id.description: Minted by `narrata-book ids`; compile rejects a missing ID.

ObjectRole.description: Lexical role order is the descriptor order, including ADR 0023 evolution metadata.

reason.description: Shown when the option is visible but disabled.

oneOf.description: Show `reply`, then continue in the same passage from `rejoin`.
Enter another node of the same graph, by alias.

tombstones.description: Deleted IDs; they are never reused, and the list only grows.

PreviewReport.description:
Preview compilation of records into program objects. A compiled preview is never a
publication: switching requires `publish` with outlines.

objects.description: Program chunks and the tombstone set, retrievable one at a time.

tombstones.description: Tombstone records the host persists atomically with the edit before publishing.

endings.description: How each outcome of the entry graph is shown when the story ends.

ProjectManifest.description: Resolved by tooling, never by the deterministic runtime.

migrated_from_r1.description:
The R1 artifact this work was migrated from; recorded in the name table so that R1
saves can only migrate onto it (ADR 0013 §10).

packages.description: Package instance alias to a path relative to the manifest.

evolution.description: ADR 0023's full MigrationId digest, addressed by the evolution role.

PublicationStatus.description:
Compiled candidates can be retained and inspected even when their outlines prevent
switching. Topology warnings do not prevent switching; missing/defective outlines do.

status.description:
`compiled` candidates can be retained and inspected; only `switchable` ones pass the
outline policy for becoming the work's current publication.

RecordIndexes.description: The derived index rows of one record, replaced together with its payload.

RecordReport.description:
A checked record set, a single checked record or a split source. `records` counts the
records available by index; it is zero whenever an error prevented a checked value.

minted.description: IDs this operation minted, in allocation order.

namespace.description: Existing RefNamespace code: save=0, branch=1, bookmark=2, active=3, temporary=4.

Scalar.description:
A state value. `text` is data that rules compare (decision 2); translatable names travel as
`ref`, which only supports equality.

Signature.description: Parameters and outcomes; checked signatures keep outcomes sorted and unique.

blocks.description: Every block anchor in document order, markers included.

markers.description: Marker blocks and the choice point each one stands for.

VisitFrontierV1.description: The only information about an unvisited choice target that may leave the map core.

artifact_id.description:
Established by the checked cursor header, even when ancestor replay cannot start.
None means that header itself was unavailable; no supplied projection can fill it in.
